arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَحَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِينَ لا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ، وَلا يَسْـأَمُـونَ مِنْ تَقْـدِيْسِكَ، وَلا يَسْتَحسِرُونَ مِنْ عِبَادَتِكَ، وَلاَ يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِي أَمْرِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa ḥamalatu ʿarshika alladhīna lāyafturūna min tasbīhika wa lā yas'amūn min taqdisika wa lā yastahsiroon min ʿibādatika wa lā yu'thiroona at-taqṣīr ʿalā al-jiddi fī amrika
english_text: O God, as for the Bearers of Thy Throne, who never flag in glorifying Thee, never become weary of calling Thee holy, never tire of worshipping Thee, never prefer curtailment over diligence in Thy command,

arabic_text: وَلا يَغْفُلُونَ عَنِ الْوَلَهِ إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: walā yaghfulūna ʿani al-walaha ilayka
english_text: and are never heedless of passionate love for Thee;

arabic_text: وَإسْرافِيْلُ صَاحِبُ الصُّوْرِ، الشَّاخِصُ الَّذِي يَنْتَظِرُ مِنْكَ الاذْنَ وَحُلُولَ الامْرِ، فَيُنَبِّهُ بِالنَّفْخَةِ صَرْعى رَهَائِنِ الْقُبُورِ. وَمِيكَآئِيلُ ذُو الْجَاهِ عِنْدَكَ، وَالْمَكَانِ الرَّفِيعِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ.
transliteration: wa isrāfīl ṣāḥibu ṣ-ṣūr, ash-shākhiṣu alladhī yantadhīr min-ka al-'adhna wa hulool al-amri, fayunabbihu bi-n-nafkhah ṣarʿā raḥāʾini al-qubūr. wa mīkāʾīl dhū al-jāhi ʿinda-k wal-makāni ar-rafiʿi min ṭāʿatika
english_text: Seraphiel, the Owner of the Trumpet, fixed in his gaze, awaiting Thy permission and the descent of the Command, that he may arouse through the Blast the hostages thrown down in the graves; Michael, possessor of standing with Thee and a raised up place in Thy obedience;

arabic_text: وَجِبْريلُ الامِينُ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ، الْمُطَاعُ فِي أَهْلِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، الْمَكِينُ لَدَيْكَ، الْمُقَرَّبُ عِنْدَكَ،
transliteration: wajibrīlul-amīnu ʿalā waḥyika al-muṭāʿu fī ahl samāwātika al-makīnu ladayka, al-muqarrabu ʿindaka
english_text: Gabriel, entrusted with Thy revelation, obeyed by the inhabitants of Thy heavens, distinguished in Thy Presence, brought nigh to Thee;

arabic_text: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ،
transliteration: war-rūḥu al-ladhī huwa ʿalá malāʾikati al-ḥujub
english_text: the spirit who is over the angels of the veils;

arabic_text: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ.
transliteration: wa al-ruḥu alladhī huwa min amrika
english_text: and the spirit who is of Thy command -

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عليهم وَعَلَى الْمَلاَئِكَـةِ الَّـذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّـانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَهْلِ الامَانَةِ عَلَى رِسَالاَتِكَ، وَالَّذِينَ لا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دؤُوب ،
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalayhim wa ʿalā al-malāʾikati al-ladhīna min dūnihim min sukkan samāwātik wa ahlil-amānati ʿalā risālātika wa alladhīna lā tadkhuluhum sa'matun min du'ūb
english_text: O God! bless them and the angels below them: the residents in Thy heavens, those entrusted with Thy messages, those who become not wearied by perseverance,

arabic_text: وَلاَ إعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلاَ فُتُورٌ، وَلاَ تَشْغَلُهُمْ عَنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ الشَّهَوَاتُ، وَلا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَـلاَتِ،
transliteration: wa lā ʾiʿyāʾun min luġūb walā futūr walā tašġaluhum ʿan tasbīḥika aš-šahawāt wa lā yaqṭaʿuhum ʿan taʿẓīmika sahwu al-ghafalāt
english_text: or exhausted and flagged by toil, whom passions distract not from glorifying Thee, and whose magnification of Thee is never cut off by the inattention of heedless moments;

arabic_text: الْخُشَّعُ الابْصارِ فلا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ ،
transliteration: al-khushshau al-absar, fa la yaroomoon al-nathara ilayka
english_text: their eyes lowered, they do not attempt to look at Thee;

arabic_text: النَّواكِسُ الاذْقانِ الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
transliteration: al-nawākis al-aḏqān alladhīna qad ṭālat raghbatohum fīmā ladayk
english_text: their chins bowed, they have long desired what is with Thee;

arabic_text: الْمُسْتَهْتِرُونَ بِذِكْرِ آلائِكَ وَالْمُتَوَاضِعُونَ دُونَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلاَلِ كِبْرِيآئِكَ
transliteration: al-mustahtirun bi dhikr aalaa'ik wal-mutawāḍiʿūna dūna ʿaẓamati-ka wa-jalāli kibriyāʾi-ka
english_text: unrestrained in mentioning Thy boons, they remain humble before Thy mightiness and the majesty of Thy magnificence;

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إذَا نَظَرُوا إلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَبَدْنَاكَ حَقَّ عِبَـادَتِكَ.
transliteration: wa alladhīna yaqūlūna idhā naẓarū ilā jahannam tazfiru ʿalā ahl maʿṣiyatika subḥānaka mā ʿabadenāka ḥaqqan ʿibādatika
english_text: those who say when they look upon Gehenna roaring over the people who disobeyed Thee: 'Glory be to Thee, we have not worshipped Thee with the worship Thou deservest!'

arabic_text: فَصَـلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ، وَ أهْلِ الزُّلْفَةِ عِنْدَكَ، وَحُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إلى رُسُلِكَ، وَالْمُؤْتَمَنِينَ على وَحْيِكَ وَقَبائِلِ الْمَلائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَأَغْنَيْتَهُمْ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ والشَّرَابِ بِتَقْدِيْسِكَ،
transliteration: fasalli ʿalayhim wa ʿala al-ruḥāniyyīn min malāʾikatika. wa ahli alzulfati ʿindaka, wa ḥummalighaybi ila rusulika wal-muʾtama'nīna 'alā waḥyika waqabā'ili'l-malā'ikati al-ladhīna akhtassahum li-nafsika wa-aghniyatahum ʿani al-ṭaʿāmi wa al-sharābi bi-taqdīsika
english_text: Bless them, and Thy angels who are the Reposeful, those of proximity to Thee, those who carry the unseen to Thy messengers, those entrusted with Thy revelation, the tribes of angels whom Thou hast singled out for Thyself, freed from need for food and drink by their calling Thee holy,

arabic_text: وَأسْكَنْتَهُمْ بُطُونَ أطْبَـاقِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَالّذينَ عَلَى أرْجَآئِهَا إذَا نَزَلَ الامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ، وَخزّانِ الْمَطَرِ وَزَوَاجِرِ السَّحَابِ، وَالّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ ألرُّعُوْدِ،
transliteration: wa 'askantahum butoonat atbaaqi samaawaatika wa-alladhīna ʿalā arjāʾihā idhā nazala-l-amru bi-tamāmi waʿdika wa khazzāni al-maṭar wa zawājiri al-sahāb wa alladhi biṣawti zajrihi yusmaʿu zajalu ar-ruʿūd
english_text: and made to dwell inside Thy heavens' layers, those who will stand upon the heavens' borders when the Command descends to complete Thy promise, the keepers of the rain, the drivers of the clouds, him at whose driving's sound is heard the rolling of thunder,

arabic_text: وَإذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السّحَـابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ.
transliteration: wa-idha sabahat bihi hafifatu as-sahabi at-tama'at sawaiqu al-buruq
english_text: and when the reverberating clouds swim before his driving, bolts of lightning flash;

arabic_text: وَمُشَيِّعِيْ الْثَلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ. وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَر إَذَا نَزَلَ، وَالْقُوَّامِ عَلَى خَزَائِنِ الرّيَاحِ، وَ المُوَكَّلِينَ بِالجِبَالِ فَلا تَزُولُ.
transliteration: wa mushayyiʿī al-thalj wa al-barad. wa al-hābitīna maʿa qaṭri al-maṭar idhā nazala wal-qouwwami ʿala khazaîni al-riyâh wa al-muwakkalīn bi-ljibāl, falā tazūl
english_text: the escorts of snow and hail, the descenders with the drops of rain when they fall, the watchers over the treasuries of the winds, those charged with the mountains lest they disappear,

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ عَرَّفْتَهُمْ مَثَاقِيلَ الْمِياهِ، وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا،
transliteration: wa alladhīna ʿarraftahum mathāqīla al-miyāh wa kayla mā taḥwīhi lawāʿiju al-amṭāri wa ʿawālijuhā
english_text: those whom Thou hast taught the weights of the waters and the measures contained by torrents and masses of rain;

arabic_text: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ إلَى أهْلِ الارْضِ بِمَكْرُوهِ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ، وَمَحْبُوبِ الرَّخَآءِ، والسَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ اَلبَرَرَةِ، وَالْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ، وَمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ وَأعْوَانِهِ، وَمُنْكَر وَنَكِير، وَرُومَانَ فَتَّانِ الْقُبُورِ،
transliteration: wa-rusulika min al-malā'ikati ilá ahli al-arḍi bi-makrūhi mā yanzilu min al-balā'i wa maḥbūbi r-rakhaʾi, wa s-safarati l-kirāmi l-bararati wa al-ḥafẓati al-kirāmi al-kātibīn, wa malaki al-mawt wa aʿwānih wa-munkar wa-nakīr, wa-rūmān fatta̅ni al-qubūr
english_text: the angels who are Thy messengers to the people of the earth with the disliked affliction that comes down and the beloved ease; the devoted, noble scribes, the watchers, noble writers, the angel of death and his helpers, Munkar and Nakir, Rumaan, the tester in the graves,

arabic_text: وَالطَّائِفِينَ بِالبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ، وَمَالِك، وَالْخَزَنَةِ، وَرُضْوَانَ، وَسَدَنَةِ الْجِنَانِ وَالَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَعْصُوْنَ اللّهَ مَا أمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ.
transliteration: walṭā'ifīna bilbayti almamūri, wamālik wal-khazanati, war-ruḍwana, wa-sadana til-jinani wa-al-ladhina la yas'uuna allaha ma amarahum wayaf'aluna ma yu'marun
english_text: the circlers of the Inhabited House, Malik and the guardians, Ridwan and the gatekeepers of the gardens, those who "disobey not God in What He commands them and do What they are commanded" (66:6);

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ: سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الـدّارِ.
transliteration: wa alladhīna yaqūlūna: salāmun ʿalaykum bimā ṣabar­tum fanīʿma ʿuqbā alddār
english_text: those who say, "Peace be upon you, for that you were patient - and fair is the Ultimate Abode" (13:24);

arabic_text: والزّبانيةُ الذّينَ إذَا قِيْـلَ لَهُمْ: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوْهُ ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوْهُ ابْتَدَرُوهُ سِرَاعاً وَلَمْ يُنْظِرُوهُ.
transliteration: wa al-zubāniyah alladhīna idhā qīla lahumm khudhūhu faghullūhu thummal-jahīma ṣallūhu ibtadarūhu sirāʿan wa lam yunẓirūhu
english_text: the Zabaniya, who, when it is said to them, "take him, and fetter him, then roast him in hell" (69:30), hasten to accomplish it, nor do they give him any respite;

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ، وَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ، وَبأيِّ أمْر وَكَّلْتَهُ. وَسُكّانُ الْهَوَآءِ وَالارْضِ وَالمآءِ، وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ تَأْتي كُلُّ نَفْس مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ،
transliteration: wa-man aw-ham-na dhik-ra-hu, wa-lam naʿlam ma-ka-na-hu min-ka wa bi-ayyi amrin wakkaltahu. wa sukkanu al-hawaa'i wa al-ardi wa al-maa'i wa-man minhum ʿalal-khalqi fasalli ʿalayhim yawma ta'ti kullu nafsin maʿaha saʾiqun wa shahidun
english_text: him whom we have failed to mention, not knowing his place with Thee, nor with which command Thou hast charged him; and the residents in the air, the earth, and the water, and those of them charged over the creatures; bless them on the day when "every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness" (50:21),

arabic_text: وَصَلّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلى كَرَامَتِهِمْ، وَطَهَارَةً عَلَى طَهَارَتِهِمْ
transliteration: wa ṣalla ʿalayhim ṣalātan tazīduhum karamatan ʿalā karamatihim wa ṭahāratun ʿalā ṭahāratihim
english_text: and bless them with a blessing that will add honour to their honour and purity to their purity.

arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ وَإذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ، وَبَلَّغْتَهُمْ صَلاَتَنَا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَصَلِّ عَلَينا بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيْهِمْ إنَّكَ جَوَاْدٌ كَرِيمٌ .
transliteration: allāhumma wa 'idhā ṣallayta ʿalā malā'ikatika wa rusulika wa ballaghtahum salaatanaa ʿalayhim, fasalli ʿalayna bimā fatḥta lanā min ḥusni-l-qawli fīhim innaka jawādun karīmun
english_text: O God, and when Thou blessest Thy angels and Thy messengers and Thou extendest our blessings to them, bless us through the good words about them which Thou hast opened up for us! Thou art Munificent, Generous.
